GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2025-01-14T15:15:45Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Known plates are not getting recorded
Description: I must be doing something wrong because I seem to be the only one facing this issue. Known plates are not being processed or registered in my setup, and all of them are missing from new detections. If I add a new plate to the known plates, past occurrences are updated in the live feed with the correct name and notes. However, when any already-known plates drive through, they are not getting registered.

I tried debugging this but made no progress. Initially, I suspected that my database might have been corrupted during the update migrations, so I performed a fresh, clean installation. Unfortunately, the issue persists.

What could I be doing wrong?
